basis: renders a native <header> landmark (aria-label when named) around slotted content — the landmark is the contract.

responsive.basis: the search slot drops to a full-width second row below the sm media query (basis-full order-last; sm:order-none sm:basis-auto and sm:flex-nowrap put it back on the brand line above) and the header height steps min-h-14 sm:h-14 3xl:h-16 — both switches answer the viewport, not the slotted content.

interaction.basis: a landmark bar hosting navigation and actions it does not operate.

exceptions.because: app-header.e2e.ts pins geometry only — keyboard passage through the surface is unproven in browser
